summary: Mine heterogeneous writing fragments through conversation without prematurely imposing an outline.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.reason: Retain the single-file fragment format, but identify invented examples and proposed claims when needed to prevent false attribution.
deltas.tradeoff: A little visible attribution interrupts an otherwise seamless notebook.

deltas.change: Replace relentless questioning with responsive pursuit
deltas.reason: Keep the interview vigorous while selecting questions by the material they can uncover and recognizing repetition.
deltas.tradeoff: The assistant must exercise editorial judgment rather than follow a forceful slogan.

deltas.reason: Stop at a pause or a user-chosen move to composition; do not smuggle in an outline.
deltas.tradeoff: A user expecting an immediate finished article needs a different workflow.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.

original_revision_reason: Independent portfolio review identified substantial overlap with thesis-stress-test. Replace the duplicate with identity-preserving creative variation.
